title: Stack vs heap

blocks.md:
## Where values live

The **stack** is the list of function calls that are running now. The **heap** is the bag of objects those frames point at.

A closure keeps a heap object alive after the stack frame that created it is gone. `await` *pauses that function* — it does not freeze the operating system.

choices.md: Stops the whole computer until the promise finishes
Pauses that function and lets other JS run

blocks.explainMd: The running function is on top. outer waits under it until inner returns.

description: Calls sit on a stack. Objects live on the heap until nothing points at them.
